text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia to issue a new hydrocarbons code. President Ben Ali recommends the setting up of a programme to restructure the petrol distribution sector.
- Tunisian and French business organisations met last week in Paris. French employers organisation delegation expected next September in Tunis.
- Culture Minister Abdelbaki Hermassi on Tuesday released the full programme of "Tunisia, regional cultural capital" for 1997.
- Barristers association head Abdelwahab Behi expresses support to President Ben Ali.
